pages.title: Flight controls
pages.text: The Flux Ship is a powered flying vehicle. Place it in a clear area and right-click to board.$(br2)W/S move forward and backward. Mouse look steers the hull left/right and pitches it up/down; A/D also turn. Hold Left Alt to look around without steering. Up/Down or Space/Backspace add vertical thrust. Release W/S to brake smoothly and hover. Sneak dismounts.

pages.title: Handling a ship
pages.text: The cockpit hologram shows speed in km/h, altitude as world Y, and your current controls.$(br2)Top speed is about 374 km/h. Acceleration, braking, turns and pitch changes build gradually. Flight follows the nose, so look up to climb and down to dive while holding W.$(br2)Disable utility.fluxShipMouseControl in ariente-client.toml for keyboard flight with independent mouse look. The free-look and weapon keys can be rebound in Controls.

pages.title: Forward laser
pages.text: Hold V to fire the front cannon, up to five shots per second. Change Fire ship laser in Controls to rebind it. Each shot deals the damage of an unupgraded Energy Lance, without ammunition.$(br2)Aim by turning and pitching the whole ship with the mouse. The hull takes time to turn: the hologram crosshair shows the actual cannon line, accounting for its position below your eyes. Holding the free-look key lets you look around while the cannon keeps its heading.

pages.title: Power exhaust
pages.text: Yellow negarite and cyan posirite power flows from the rear engine bay in curling strands. The exhaust grows longer and brighter as the ship gains speed, then fades as it slows.$(br2)The engine hum also grows with speed, with a gently rising pitch. It fades to silence when the ship stops.$(br2)Switch to third person to see your ship's exhaust. You can also see it on other ships while watching them fly.

pages.title: Cockpit view
pages.text: First-person banking can be reduced with utility.fluxShipCameraTilt (0 to 1) in ariente-client.toml.$(br2)The third-person camera stays upright. Mouse steering works there too; hold the free-look key to inspect the ship. The pilot model stays seated and tilts with the hull.$(br2)An unattended ship coasts and slowly sinks to the ground, including after reloads. It cannot avoid obstacles. Sneak-hit it to recover its item.

pages.title: Charging and endurance
pages.text: Crafted ships and ships from the creative inventory start empty. The cockpit shows No power until charged.$(br2)Center the ship just above a Flux Ship Charger and stop to recharge. Connect both negarite and posirite power, separately or through a combined cable. A full charge takes about one minute.$(br2)The cockpit charge bar shows stored power. A full battery lasts about 20 minutes at full speed; hovering and descent use much less. Empty ships gently descend. Picking up and replacing a ship preserves its charge.

pages.title: Flux Ship Charger
pages.text: Build the Charger in the Constructor using its common blueprint. Its animated top glows while both power types are available. A black field means power is missing.$(br2)The charger only supplies a stationary ship centered directly above it; ships flying past or higher overhead do not recharge.
